name: Z2Labs EMS
description: EM simulation of PCBs in KiCad: ports, stackup, mesh preview, S-parameters, currents and voltages on the board (openEMS-based).
description_full:
Electromagnetic (FDTD) simulation of the open board from inside the PCB editor.

- Ports as a + pad and its ground reference (connector GND pads, IC GND pins or the plane below), picked from the PCB editor selection and drawn as markers on a user layer (no DRC/ERC impact).
- Fab stackup presets (JLCPCB 2-layer and 4-layer, own JSON).
- Mesh preview on a user layer with cell count and run-time estimate.
- Simulate: S-parameters (Touchstone), line impedance and effective permittivity, 3D viewer.
- Fields of every run, scaled to 1 W: surface current maps with current lines and layer voltages with iso-voltage lines on the board; a 3D viewer with arrows, phase animation and E-field cut planes.
- Two-pad R/L/C footprints are simulated as lumped elements.

The solver is the Z2 EMS engine (openEMS with a CUDA engine, conformal metal edges and a KiCad importer, GPL-3.0). It is a separate download of about 160 MB: on Windows the plugin offers to download and install it on first use (from github.com/z2labs/z2ems/releases, SHA-256 checked); on Linux and macOS it is built from source and the plugin is pointed to its folder.

Requires KiCad 10 with the IPC API server enabled (Preferences > Plugins).
